ask.description:
Ask for a refund, e.g. "Please refund $30 on order A-1001, the desk arrived
scratched".

RefundTask.description: What the session is for: one customer's refund request, and the warrant scoped to it.

warrant.description: The Tenuo warrant for this refund request, in base64. It names the order the agent may act on and how much it may refund. `just session A-1001` issues one and starts the session with it.
warrant.title: Warrant
